_about: Where each piece of the Blueprint runs. both means Claude Code on a computer and Claude Duet. pc means a desktop install only. duet means Claude Duet only. The duet field says how it does on Duet's cloud computer. The build reads this file to pick the skills it packs for Duet.

targets.both: Claude Code on a computer and Claude Duet
targets.pc: A desktop install with Claude Code only

duet_status.blocked: Installs, but Duet's network blocks the sites it needs
duet_status.skill: Save it as a claude.ai skill
duet_status.connector: Duet uses a connector or connection for this
duet_status.fits: Save the packed skill as is
duet_status.bundle: Save the packed skill; its scripts travel inside it
duet_status.covered: Duet already does this another way

setup.name: setup.cmd, setup.command, setup/setup.ps1, setup/setup.sh
setup.why: The desktop installer. It installs Claude Code and the programs, then opens Claude.

setup.name: update.cmd, update.command
setup.why: Double-click updaters for a desktop install.

setup.name: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md
setup.why: Map files Claude Code, Codex and Gemini read on their own.

setup.name: setup/cloud-programs.sh
setup.why: Puts the programs back after each rebuild of the cloud computer.

setup.name: Chromium from npm
setup.why: Duet's network blocks the usual browser downloads, so setup/cloud-programs.sh gets one from npm. Remotion renders with it.

setup.name: skill-uploads/
setup.why: One zip per skill to save in claude.ai, with its scripts packed inside.

setup.name: setup/SETUP.md, setup/filing-styles.md, tools/, _reference/
setup.why: The setup conversation, the six filing styles, the scripts and the reference notes.

skills.why: Motion graphics with Remotion. Rendered here with the npm Chromium.

skills.name: video-shots
skills.why: Shot recipes for promos. Libraries cloned here.
skills.duet_note: Remotion's working copy here is `/opt/wb-motion`. Build shots in `/opt/wb-motion/src/compositions/`, and copy any shot worth keeping into the workspace, since that copy is lost when the computer is rebuilt. Before a render run `source /tmp/wb-browser.env`.
